key_insight: MGE-PO refines correctness-based credit assignment with generation entropy, giving larger bonuses to lower-entropy successes and larger penalties to higher-entropy failures.
engineering_relevance: The approach uses rollout uncertainty to differentiate equally rewarded responses during reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning.
method: Apply four-quadrant advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy.
Use correctness to set the correction’s sign and entropy to control its magnitude.
Support training with an online entropy-based question curriculum using cached rollout measurements.
evidence_signal: After eight epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three optimization settings improved six-benchmark macro avg@32 by 3.23–3.69 percentage points and pass@32 by 4.24–11.06 points; the full Qwen2.5-7B-Base configuration raised four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify entropy-measurement overhead or establish generalization beyond the reported models and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
paper_title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
